intro: The sea splits under a heavy swell.
introDialogue: That Wailord is blocking the route. Hit too hard and this gets dangerous, but if you cannot control it, the ship will not move. Show me what you can do in three turns.
speaker: Misty
title: Sea Rescue Drill
description:
Misty offers a rescue drill against Wailord.
Lower Wailord's HP as much as possible within 3 turns to earn a better reward.

1.label: Join the Drill
1.tooltip:
(!) 3-turn battle against Wailord
(+) Rewards based on remaining HP
1.selected: All right, let's begin! Push hard before time runs out!

2.label: Move On
2.selected: This is not the time to overdo it.

greatResult: Nice work! That was a clean restraint.
goodResult: Not bad. You can handle yourself at sea.
badResult: Close, but Wailord still had too much strength left.
